scripts.lint: npm run lint -w cgdn1-web && eslint tools firmware/test
scripts.format: npm run format:js && npm run format:py && npm run format:c && npm run format:sh
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:js && npm run format:check:py && npm run format:check:c && npm run format:check:sh
scripts.format:sh: git ls-files -z '*.sh' | xargs -0 uvx --from shfmt-py==4.2.0 shfmt -w
scripts.format:check:sh: git ls-files -z '*.sh' | xargs -0 uvx --from shfmt-py==4.2.0 shfmt -d
scripts.lint:sh: git ls-files -z '*.sh' | xargs -0 uvx --from shellcheck-py==0.11.0.1 shellcheck
scripts.embed: npm run build -w web && gzip -9 -n -c web/dist/index.html > firmware/components/api/app.html.gz
scripts.embed:check: npm run build -w web && gunzip -c firmware/components/api/app.html.gz | cmp -s - web/dist/index.html || { echo 'firmware/components/api/app.html.gz is out of date: run npm run embed'; exit 1; }
